source_description_html:
Helite GP Air Track Vest

Practical, lightweight and discreet with an aerodynamic design and flexible fit, the Helite GP Air Track  Airbag Vest is specially developed for the race track. It also works for leather jackets with humps for the street rider. With the GP Air Track Vest there is no front zipper or buckle on the chest. This is in order to allow the rider much more ease when sliding from side to side on the tank. With the integrated foam surrounding the cartridge area, you won’t even notice it’s there.

Note: The vest runs small. We recommend ordering 2 sizes larger.

Features:

  • Full protection for the rider’s back, neck, spine, chest, ribs, pelvis, head, pancreas, liver, lungs, etc. with an inflation time​ of 75-milliseconds​ for optimal pressure
  • Turtle Technology is a similar principle to that of a motorcycle helmet: hard shell exterior with a soft impact interior. A  big improvement on an
    incredible safety innovation, Turtle Technology results in the absorption and distribution of high velocity impacts
  • Designed and tested on race tracks by racers for racers. The GP Air’s tight body fit has been designed with stretch panels on the side and space for your race leather’s hump in mind
  • Constructed with strong abrasion resistant perforated leather (cowhide 1.2mm) as well as a foam lining to protect the airbag chamber
  • Accordion leather stretch panels at sides
  • VELCRO® brand back sliders at either side of the vest
  • Quick and easy to replace CO2 cartridge can be done by the rider in minutes following deployment
  • 100% mechanically triggered avoids airbag deployment and also eliminates the need for batteries or complicated system calibration
  • Added feature gives rider zipper access to stitch on logos for various sponsors
  • All sizes use 60CC air cartridge

Sizing:

(This size chart is for information only. The most important is to have a close-fitting GP-Air Vest for the aerodynamics and it must go down ~4 inches under the iliac crest (hip bone).

  • SM: 5'0"-5'5" Waist 26"-31"

  • LG-L: 5'6"-6'2" Waist 32"-37"

source_description_html:
The world’s fastest selling airbag product – the Helite Turtle 2 has now gone wireless!

The NEW Helite E turtle incorporates the same iconic design as the Helite Turtle 2 with the added benefit of autonomous inflation of the wireless, electronically activated airbag.

The E turtle incorporates algorithm technology into the vest which analyses the user’s movements and automatically triggers the airbag to inflate in less an 80ms. Detection also includes loss of control and accidents where you may not separate fully from your motorbike.

There is also an optional Bike Fork Sensor which is capable of communicating with the vest and detects impacts (e.g. tree, wall, car) including when stationary 0km/hr (e.g. impact by a 3rd party vehicle).

source_description_html:
The big advantage of the Helite Turtle 2.0 is its universal applicability, you only need one vest for the whole season, regardless of the outside temperature or the country you are travelling to.

The special feature of the Turtle Airbag Vest is its construction. The high-quality SAS-Tec back protector lies like a turtle shell over the airbag. In addition to the protection provided by the airbag, point loads are distributed and absorbed over the entire airbag in the back area. The protection is therefore many times higher than with a standard airbag.

Features:
  • mechanical release, thus maintenance-free
  • Airbag capacity: 17 - 24 litres
  • Airbag filling time: 80 - 100 milliseconds
  • unlimited trigger number
  • SAS-Tec back protector
Specifications: What the Turtle offers you:
  • 17 - 24 litres of protective volume for neck, spine, thorax, pelvis, coccyx, head, collarbone and internal organs
  • a long service life, due to high-quality workmanship
  • individual adjustment of the width at all 3 buckles
  • different colours and sizes
  • ergonomic fit
  • large armholes for optimal fit 
What was improved in Turtle 2.0:
  • soft collar, without velcro fastener
  • the trigger mechanism, as well as the capsule are now concealed and no longer visible, thus also more protected
  • the design was revised, the black and coloured vest now also has reflective stripes
  • more robust buckles are used, which can be opened more easily with gloves
airbag technology:
  • The Turtle 2.0 continues to provide optimum protection. The airbag technology was adopted unchanged from the predecessor model. You can find out more about airbag and turtle technology on the Helite information page on airbag technology.
Protection:
  • the SAS-Tec protector in combination with the shock-absorbing air cushion ensures optimum shock absorption and protection against punctures
  • very high abrasion resistance due to 600D textile material to protect the airbag chamber

source_description_html:
The Helite e-GP-Air offers a brand new technology for maximum protection on the track. A true revolution in protection and detection! The electronic airbag vest uses a multi-sensor detection that allows a complete analysis of the situation and a complete 360 ° protection. The algorithm uses a series of sensors (accelerometer, gyroscope and GPS) that analyze the movement of the motorcyclist and allow it to follow the rider in real time. The fast detection time of 60 ms fully inflates the airbag upon deployment even before ground impact.

The optional Full Protection solution includes a second sensor (SDU) to be mounted on the fork of the motorcycle. This option makes it possible in road traffic to reduce the detection time from 60 ms (only by sensors in the vests) to 31 ms even at standstill, low speed and regardless of the impact angle. However, the fork sensor should not be used on the race track.

Features:
  • based on the Turtle Airbag model
  • is triggered electronically
  • very high abrasion resistance
  • body-hugging fit with elastic material on the sides and space for the hump
  • easy to open even with gloves
  • large armholes for unrestricted freedom of movement
  • electronic system is fully integrated in vest
  • high quality SAS-TEC back and chest protectors, which are mounted over the airbag like a turtle shell
  • punctual loads in the back area are effectively distributed and absorbed by the entire airbag
  • Velcro areas on the back, which are equipped with removable leather sliders (can be replaced individually in the event of a fall)
  • when released, the system has the optimum pressure after 80-100 milliseconds (depending on size) to provide full protection
  • provides protection for neck, spine, chest, pelvis, coccyx, head, collarbone and internal organs
  • by simply replacing the e-cartridge, the vest is immediately ready for use again after a triggering event (provided there is no external damage)
Specifications:
  • protection volume: 18 liters
  • fall detection: 60 ms
  • airbag inflation time: 60 - 80 ms (depending on size)
